name: ai-ins-workspace
description: AI Ins plugins for Vite, Webpack and more bundlers.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @ai-ins/core build && pnpm --filter @ai-ins/vite build && pnpm --filter @ai-ins/playground-vite dev
scripts.dev:webpack: pnpm --filter @ai-ins/core build && pnpm --filter @ai-ins/webpack build && pnpm --parallel --filter @ai-ins/core --filter @ai-ins/webpack --filter @ai-ins/playground-webpack dev
scripts.dev:webpack:once: pnpm --filter @ai-ins/core build && pnpm --filter @ai-ins/webpack build && pnpm --filter @ai-ins/playground-webpack dev
